mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 2% signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates on equities and compressing future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC exceeds 0.03 over any 2-year window during tightening periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% indicates a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When demand (GDPC1) outpaces supply (INDPRO) by 5% over a month, inflationary pressures rise, elevating equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 exceeds INDPRO by 5% over 1 month
failure_condition: If returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction effect (Rank IC) falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent easing (FEDFUNDS decline) and rising demand (GDPC1 increase) create a dual positive signal, amplifying S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls while GDPC1 rises over 1 month
failure_condition: If returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction effect (Rank IC) is below 0.03 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a drop in UNRATE below 4.5% strengthens the labor market signal, enhancing consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 2% during a tightening cycle increases discount rates on equities, reducing expected future cash flows and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC exceeds 0.03 over any 2-year window during tightening periods.

mechanism_narrative: When demand (HOUST) outpaces supply (INDPRO) by 3% over two months, inflationary pressures intensify, driving up equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST exceeds INDPRO by 3% over 2 months
failure_condition: If returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction effect (Rank IC) falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
